void-canvas.$description: Void Canvas — Page backgrounds and uninterrupted full-bleed section canvas

ink-surface.$description: Ink Surface — Inset page regions, dark filled controls, and low-level card surfaces

charcoal-panel.$description: Charcoal Panel — Product-demo panels, card fills, dark text on white controls, and structural borders

steel-panel.$description: Steel Panel — Raised dark controls and secondary panel layers

slate-edge.$description: Slate Edge — Fine borders around dark demo panes, tabs, and outlined controls

cloud-white.$description: Cloud White — High-emphasis headings, icons, filled action surfaces, and logo marks

frost-text.$description: Frost Text — Lead paragraphs and lower-emphasis navigation text

misted-slate.$description: Misted Slate — Muted body copy, inactive tabs, secondary links, and product-interface labels

quiet-slate.$description: Quiet Slate — Metadata, subdued icons, and tertiary product-interface text

signal-violet.$description: Signal Violet — Brand symbol, selected product icons, and violet light sources — a narrowly deployed signal against the black canvas

violet-atmosphere.$description: Violet Atmosphere — Soft demo-edge illumination and decorative feature-section washes

slate-lift.$description: Slate Lift — Subtle upward background haze behind contained product visuals

inter.$description: Use throughout. Weight 500 carries navigation, labels, and display headings; 400 carries explanatory copy; 600 is reserved for compact feature titles and high-emphasis white controls. The 500-weight 48px display treatment is intentionally quieter than a 700-weight marketing headline.
